LESSON: SCRIPTURES AND MORAL VALUES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures
Topic 3.1: Scriptures and Moral values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Scriptures and Moral values. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do Scriptural stories contribute to instilling moral values?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the teachings of Scriptures that enhance moral values for familiarisation

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Scriptures and Moral values helps you communicate well at school and at home.

• Listen with your eyes and ears. Face the speaker and wait for your turn.

• When you speak, use a clear voice and polite words.

• Practise short dialogues with a partner using Kenyan school situations.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short instruction, then repeat it to a friend in your own words.

Example 3: Role-play buying an item at the market using polite requests: “Please…”, “Thank you.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Practise a 30-second greeting dialogue with a partner.
2. Listen to three instructions and carry them out in order.
3. Tell a short news item from your day using complete sentences.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Teach a younger learner one polite greeting from this lesson.
2. Write five sentences you can say when welcoming a visitor at school.
3. Ask a parent to give you three oral instructions; write them down after listening.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read scriptures that enhance moral values, in groups,
2. Listen to stories/resource persons/audio- visual devices to know about the role of the Scriptures,
3. Digital Literacy: Learner enhances digital skills when using search engines to identify the Scriptural stories that enhance moral values in the community.
4. Can relate the skills of socialising and sharing stories from Scriptures that explain their roles as carriers of moral values to the skills learnt in Social Studies.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do Scriptural stories contribute to instilling moral values?
2. How can we apply teachings of scriptures to instilling moral values?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Good listeners look, wait, and respond.
2. Clear speech helps others understand you.
3. Polite language shows respect.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
